description:
Sometimes an escape is all we need to break up the routine of everyday life. Quick vacations of the mind where we can step back, and allow ourselves a moment to take a deep breath and appreciate how far we’ve come. Barron fitness bike is here to provide just that. We have created the perfect companion to transport you into your own state of mental bliss. Leave the tick-tock of the city behind and pedal your way past the norm on a pure comfort bike. Discover the land you live in like never before and find the serenity that comes with a bike ride well spent.
THE FRAME
Barron's sturdy yet lightweight 6061 frame provides strength and agility and is designed to take on a variety of terrains. Perfect for fitness training or leisurely day trips.
THE PARTS
This bike features a zoom suspension fork that soaks up the bumps for increased comfort and improved handling. Barron also comes equipped with name brand components such as a Shimano Tourney 21 speed drivetrain and Megarange gearing that allow for fast and easy gear changes, which makes cycling for your commute, fitness, or weekend ride a gratifying experience.
THE PIECES
Barron's Kenda Kwest tires come equipped with a semi slick tread and water dispersion grooves to provide all weather versatility and the ability to flexibly ride in just about any environment. Additional features such as a comfort saddle, twist grip shifters, ergonomic brake levers and a sturdy rear mount kickstand provide everything you need for a day spent gallivanting through a variety of terrains.

*Due to differences in screen resolutions, please note that colors may differ slightly.
